text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is finally underway! Who 
will claim the title of the strongest 
Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how it'll go today. There are 
rumors that Rice Shower has been improving 
a lot lately, too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's a 3000m long-distance race this time, 
so it really is unpredictable, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know Bourbon can pull it off! Do your 
best, 'Child of the Slopes'...!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: Go, Bourbon...!

The excitement from the stands reached all 
the way to the underground paddock tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master. An error has occurred.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Deep in my chest feels kind of... 
itchy... Detecting a sensation akin to 
levitation."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Resolution method: unknown. Master, do you 
happen to know the resolution flow 
regarding this matter?
choice_data_list: Bourbon, let's take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received. Commencing deep breathing. 
Inhale...... exhale....... Inhale......

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Phew......

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I have confirmed the cessation of the 
itch. Thank you, Master."
choice_data_list: Calm down, now go out there and win!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Running in the Triple Crown has been 
my "dream" since childhood. This summer, I 
was able to reaffirm that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will achieve victory without fail.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bourbon-san……!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, about what happened during the Nippon 
Derby... I'm so sorry for causing 
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, it wasn't particularly a 'nuisance.'

Looking closely, Rice Shower's knees were 
covered in lots of tiny scrapes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Diagnosed as an abrasion from training. 
You must have done some pretty hard 
training, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I ran so much this summer...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to catch up to Miss Bourbon... 
No.

Rice Shower, who had been timid until now, 
looked up at Mihono Bourbon with 
determination in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I wanted to beat Miss Bourbon...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice finally realized it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just admiring isn't enough, just chasing 
isn't enough... that's what I realized.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I have to chase after them, surpass them, 
and become what Rice truly wants to be...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even if... it gets in the way of 
Bourbon-san's feelings...!

Her purple eyes gleamed fiercely. Her 
usual timid self was nowhere to be seen, 
making her look like an entirely different 
person.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Analysis result: judged as 'fighting 
spirit.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I understand your "feelings", Rice-san. 
However... I also—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I cannot yield. Because that is my "will."

Perhaps inspired by Rice Shower's fighting 
spirit, a fire was burning deep within her 
eyes before long.

Exchanging a fiery glance, the two turned 
their eyes toward the racetrack.

Beyond the white light, countless fans are 
eagerly awaiting the entrance of the two.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...It is time. Preparations complete. 
After you, Master."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: See you after the race.

As if on cue from those words, the two 
dashed off toward the stage of their 
showdown.
